title: Map page: periodic table view
description:
Build `/map/` with the tabs Table, Graph and River, with Table as the default (Map artboard, https://claude.ai/artifact/EoXGtpzsayij4d7tmrfZ9r).

The table:
- Columns are stable, curated task groups (Decide, Route, Guard & judge, Speak, Language, Code, See), stored as publication data.
- Rows are total parameters; mixture-of-experts models show total and active.
- Tile borders show the licence; tiles carry two-letter symbols and an "on X" mark for "built on".
- Hosted-only models sit in a row below the table.
- Gaps read "Nothing we track yet".
- Crowded cells show "+N more".

It needs model entities with `taskGroup`, `parametersTotal`, `parametersActive`, `licence`, `symbol` and `builtOn` from Papyrus (engine ask). Until then, build it from item front matter in `web/hooks.py` and mark it Edited by AI.

Acceptance:
- The live table matches the artboard.
- Every tile links to its signal.
- No size is derived from file size.
- The page works at 390 px with horizontal scroll inside its own box.
